en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European street lined with old multi‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. On the right are several shopfronts with hanging signs and posters; on the left a row of large leafy trees and a traditional street lamp. Further along the street stands a larger institutional or religious building with a high gabled roof and an elegant tower topped by a cross. A few pedestrians, including children, walk along the cobbled and dirt roadway. Handwritten markings appear vertically on the left margin of the image.
